reading.en: Mei just arrived in California. She is at the airport. A man walks to her and says, "Hello! Are you Mei?" Mei smiles and says, "Yes, I'm Mei. Nice to meet you!" The man says, "Hi Mei, I'm Mr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Welcome to California!"
reading.cn: 梅刚到加州。她在机场。一个男人走向她，说：“你好！你是梅吗？”梅笑了笑说：“是的，我叫梅。很高兴认识你！”男人说：“嗨，梅，我是史密斯先生。也很高兴认识你。欢迎来到加州！”

reading.en: Mei is now at her host family's house. Mrs. Johnson greets her at the door. "Hello Mei! Welcome! I'm Mrs. Johnson." Mei replies, "Hi Mrs. Johnson. Nice to meet you!" Mrs. Johnson shows Mei to her room. Mei feels happy and a little bit nervous.
reading.cn: 梅现在在寄宿家庭的家里。约翰逊夫人开门迎接她。“你好，梅！欢迎！我是约翰逊夫人。”梅回答说：“嗨，约翰逊夫人。很高兴认识你！”约翰逊夫人带梅参观了她的房间。梅感到开心又有点紧张。

reading.en: Mei meets Mr. Johnson at dinner. "Hello Mei! I'm Mr. Johnson. Nice to meet you!" Mei says, "Nice to meet you too, Mr. Johnson." The family starts to chat. Mei learns about her new home. She is excited about her new life in California.
reading.cn: 梅在晚餐时见到了约翰逊先生。“你好，梅！我是约翰逊先生。很高兴认识你！”梅说：“很高兴认识你，约翰逊先生。”一家人开始聊天。梅了解了她的新家。她对在加州的新生活感到兴奋。

reading.en: The next morning, Mei goes to the kitchen. "Good morning!" says Mr. Johnson. "Good morning, Mr. Johnson! I'm Mei." Mei feels more comfortable now. This is her new home.
reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅来到厨房。“早上好！”约翰逊先生说。“早上好，约翰逊先生！我是梅。”梅现在感觉更舒服了。这是她的新家。

reading.cn: 梅今天抵达美国。她有点紧张。在机场，一位友善的女士走向她。“你好，”女士说，“我叫莎拉。你叫什么名字？”梅笑了。“嗨，我是梅。很高兴见到你，莎拉。”莎拉回答，“我也很高兴见到你，梅。欢迎来到美国！”
reading.en: Mei arrived in America today. She is a little nervous. At the airport, a friendly lady walks to her. “Hello,” the lady says. “My name is Sarah. What is your name?” Mei smiles. “Hi, I’m Mei. Nice to meet you, Sarah.” Sarah replies, “Nice to meet you, too, Mei. Welcome to America!”

reading.cn: 梅现在感觉好一些了。莎拉是她的寄宿家庭妈妈。她们走向停车场。莎拉问：“你累了吗，梅？”梅摇摇头。“不，我很好。谢谢你。”
reading.en: Mei feels a little bit better now. Sarah is her host mother. They walk to the parking lot. Sarah asks, “Are you tired, Mei?” Mei shakes her head. “No, I’m fine. Thank you.”

reading.cn: 在车里，莎拉谈论她的家人。“我丈夫叫汤姆。我女儿叫莉莉。她十岁了。我们很高兴你来了。”梅听着并微笑着。她很高兴来到这里。
reading.en: In the car, Sarah talks about her family. “My husband’s name is Tom. My daughter is Lily. She is ten. We are excited you are here.” Mei listens and smiles. She is happy to be here.

reading.cn: “路途遥远，”莎拉说，“你饿了吗？”梅说：“有点。”莎拉笑了。“别担心。我们回家会吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。”
reading.en: “It’s a long journey,” Sarah says. “Are you hungry?” Mei says, “A little.” Sarah laughs. “Don’t worry. We will have a nice dinner at home.”

grammar.title: 打招呼和介绍自己 (Greetings and Self-introduction)
grammar.explain: 在英语中，当遇到新朋友或想介绍自己时，我们通常会用“Hello”或“Hi”开头。然后用“My name is...”或“I’m...”来告诉对方你的名字。当对方介绍自己后，我们可以回应“Nice to meet you.”来表示很高兴认识对方。

examples.en: Hello, my name is Mei.
Hi, I'm Sarah.
Nice to meet you, Mei.
I am Mei.
My name is Sarah.
She is ten.

grammar.explain: “is”和“am”都是动词“be”的形式，表示“是”。“am”用于第一人称单数“I”（我），“is”用于第三人称单数“he/she/it”（他/她/它）或单数名词。它们在介绍自己和说明情况时非常常用。
grammar.title: Be动词 (is/am)

reading.en: Mei lives with a host family in the US. Every morning, she gets up at 7 o'clock. She usually takes a quick shower and then gets dressed. For breakfast, the host mom, Mrs. Smith, often makes toast and eggs. Mei usually has a glass of milk. At 8 o'clock, Mei leaves the house and walks to the bus stop. The bus takes her to school. Her classes start at 8:30.
reading.cn: 梅在美国和寄宿家庭住在一起。每天早上，她七点钟起床。她通常快速冲个澡，然后穿好衣服。早餐，寄宿妈妈史密斯太太经常做吐司和鸡蛋。梅通常会喝一杯牛奶。八点钟，梅离开家，步行到公交车站。公交车把她送到学校。她的课在八点半开始。

reading.en: Mrs. Smith: Good morning, Mei! Did you sleep well?
reading.cn: 史密斯太太：早上好，梅！你睡得好吗？
梅：早上好，史密斯太太。是的，我睡得很好，谢谢。现在几点了？
reading.en: Mei: Good morning, Mrs. Smith. Yes, I slept very well, thank you. What time is it?
Mrs. Smith: It's 7:15. Breakfast is almost ready. Do you want toast or cereal?
reading.cn: 史密斯太太：七点一刻。早餐快好了。你想吃吐司还是麦片？
梅：请给我吐司。再来一杯牛奶。谢谢！
reading.en: Mei: Toast, please. And a glass of milk. Thank you!

reading.en: Mei is at San Francisco International Airport, SFO. This is her first time in the USA. She looks at her boarding pass. 'Oh no, I can't find my gate!' she thinks. She sees a lady with an airport uniform. Mei walks to her and says, 'Excuse me, can you help me?' The lady smiles and says, 'Of course! What do you need?' Mei shows her the boarding pass. 'I need to find Gate A12.' The lady points, 'Go straight, then turn left. It's near the coffee shop.' Mei says, 'Thank you! Thank you very much!'

The pizza arrives. It smells delicious. Mia takes a big bite. "Mmm, this is so good!" she says. Her dad agrees, "Yes, it's my favorite, too." They watch a movie and enjoy their pizza. It's a happy Friday night.

米娅的小弟弟汤姆指着披萨。“我喜欢奶酪！” 他说。妈妈笑了。“是的，汤姆。给你多加点奶酪。” 大家都很开心地吃披萨当晚餐。

reading.en: After dinner, Mia helps her mom clean up. "That was a fun pizza night," Mia says. "I like pizza nights!" Her mom says, "Me too, sweetie. It's our special Friday tradition."

It's a nice house." "That's great!" Anna says. "Maybe we can walk to class together sometimes."

reading.en: It's Mei's first morning with her host family. She walks into the kitchen. Mrs. Smith is making breakfast. "Good morning, Mei! Did you sleep well?" Mrs. Smith asks. Mei smiles. "Good morning, Mrs. Smith. Yes, thank you." Mrs. Smith continues, "What would you like for breakfast? We have toast, cereal, and fruit. And for drinks, coffee, tea, milk, and orange juice." Mei thinks for a moment. "I'd like a coffee, please. And some toast." "No problem! Do you take milk or sugar in your coffee?" Mrs. Smith asks. "Just a little milk, please. No sugar." Mei says. "Coming right up!" says Mrs. Smith.

grammar.title: Do you like...? / What would you like...?

examples.en: Do you like coffee?
What would you like for breakfast?
Do you like tea or coffee?

grammar.explain:
这两个问句都用于询问对方的偏好或意愿，但在语境和含义上有所区别。

**Do you like...?** 用于询问对方是否普遍喜欢某种事物，表达的是一种长期的偏好或习惯。答案通常是肯定或否定的。

**What would you like...?** 是 “What would you like to have/eat/drink...?” 的简略形式，用于礼貌地询问对方此时此地想要什么，表达的是一种即时的选择或请求。它通常用于点餐、提供选择或询问对方的需求。答案通常是具体的选择。

reading.cn: 周六早上。梅很高兴！这是她在寄宿家庭的第一个周末。她打开窗户。“今天天气真好！”她说。史密斯太太走了进来。“早上好，梅！你睡得好吗？”梅笑了。“是的，谢谢。天气真好！”史密斯太太点点头。“是的，今天很暖和。非常适合野餐！”梅的眼睛亮了起来。“野餐？真的吗？”史密斯太太笑了。“当然！午饭后我们还可以去公园。今天没有风，很适合散步。”
reading.en: It's Saturday morning. Mei is happy! It's her first weekend at the host family's home. She opens the window. "It's sunny today!" she says. Mrs. Smith comes in. "Good morning, Mei! Did you sleep well?" Mei smiles. "Yes, thank you. The weather is so nice!" Mrs. Smith nods. "Yes, it's a warm day. Perfect for a picnic!" Mei's eyes light up. "A picnic? Really?" Mrs. Smith laughs. "Of course! And maybe we can go to the park after lunch. It isn't windy today, so it's good for a walk."

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅和史密斯一家在公园里。阳光明媚。“一点也不冷！”梅说，很享受这天气。史密斯先生指着天空。“看，梅！有点云，但仍然是晴天。”孩子们在玩耍。对梅来说，这是一个完美的第一个周末。
reading.en: Later that day, Mei and the Smiths are at the park. The sun is shining. "It's not cold at all!" Mei says, enjoying the weather. Mr. Smith points to the sky. "Look, Mei! A few clouds, but it's still sunny." The children are playing. It's a perfect first weekend for Mei.

reading.cn: 周日，梅又望向窗外。“哦，今天有点多云，”她想。史密斯太太走了进来。“早上好，梅！没有昨天那么晴朗，但没下雨。我们晚点还是可以出去的。”梅很高兴。即使是多云，她的第一个周末也依然很棒。
reading.en: On Sunday, Mei looks out the window again. "Oh, it's a bit cloudy today," she thinks. Mrs. Smith comes in. "Good morning, Mei! Not as sunny as yesterday, but it's not rainy. We can still go out later." Mei is happy. Even if it's cloudy, her first weekend is still wonderful.

reading.cn: 梅给家里的朋友发短信：“我这边的第一个周末很棒！今天多云，但昨天晴朗又暖和。我们去野餐了！你那边天气怎么样？”她的朋友回复：“我这边下雨了。我真希望我也在那里！”
reading.en: Mei texts her friend back home: "My first weekend here is great! Today it's cloudy, but yesterday was sunny and warm. We had a picnic! What's the weather like there?" Her friend replies: "It's rainy here. I wish I was there!"

reading.cn: 梅上周搬到纽约。她和寄宿家庭布朗一家住在一起。这是她的第一周，梅有点紧张，但也感到兴奋。她的房间又好又干净。她有自己的床和一个小书桌。梅和布朗的女儿艾米丽共用浴室。艾米丽非常友好和乐于助人。周一早上，布朗太太向梅展示了如何使用厨房。梅正在努力适应这个家庭的日常作息。白天每个人都很忙。晚上，他们经常一起吃晚饭。梅和布朗一家相处得很自在。她想，“这是一个好的开始！”
reading.en: Mei moved to New York last week. She lives with a host family, the Browns. It's her first week, and Mei is a little nervous, but also excited. Her room is nice and clean. She has her own bed and a small desk. Mei shares the bathroom with Emily, the Browns' daughter. Emily is very friendly and helpful. On Monday morning, Mrs. Brown showed Mei how to use the kitchen. Mei is trying to get used to the family's routine. Everyone is busy during the day. In the evenings, they often eat dinner together. Mei feels comfortable with the Browns. She thinks, "This is a good start!"

Mei: Good morning, Mrs. Brown!
Mrs. Brown: Good morning, Mei! Did you sleep well?
Mei: Yes, thank you. The bed is very comfortable.
Mrs. Brown: That's good to hear. We usually have breakfast at 7:30. Emily leaves for school at 8:00.
Mei: Okay, I understand. I want to help with breakfast.
Mrs. Brown: Oh, that's very kind of you, Mei! You can help set the table.
Mei: Sure! I'm happy to help. I want to get used to the routine quickly.
reading.cn:
梅：早上好，布朗太太！
布朗太太：早上好，梅！你睡得好吗？
梅：是的，谢谢。床很舒服。
布朗太太：那太好了。我们通常7:30吃早餐。艾米丽8:00去学校。
梅：好的，我明白了。我想帮忙做早餐。
布朗太太：哦，梅，你真好！你可以帮忙摆餐具。
梅：当然！我很乐意帮忙。我想尽快适应这个日常。

艾米丽：嗨，梅！你好吗？
梅：嗨，艾米丽！我很好，谢谢。整理东西有点忙。
艾米丽：是啊，第一周总是这样。你需要帮助吗？
梅：也许待会儿需要。我需要打开我的行李箱。而且我的手机在这里不工作。你待会儿能帮我吗？
艾米丽：当然，没问题！如果你愿意，我们今天下午可以去手机店。
梅：那太有帮助了！谢谢你，艾米丽！
艾米丽：不客气！我们很高兴你在这里。
reading.en:
Emily: Hi Mei! How are you doing?
Mei: Hi Emily! I'm good, thanks. A little busy with getting organized.
Emily: Yeah, the first week is always like that. Do you need any help?
Mei: Maybe later. I need to unpack my suitcase. And my phone is not working here. Can you help me with that later?
Emily: Sure, no problem! We can go to the phone store this afternoon if you like.
Mei: That would be very helpful! Thank you, Emily!
Emily: No worries! We're happy you're here.

Mr. Brown: Mei, how was your first week here?
Mei: It was good, Mr. Brown. Everyone is very kind. I feel comfortable.
Mr. Brown: That's important! We want you to feel at home. Do you have any questions?
Mei: Not right now, thank you. I'm just happy to be here.
Mr. Brown: Wonderful! Welcome to our family.
reading.cn:
布朗先生：梅，你在这里的第一周过得怎么样？
梅：很好，布朗先生。每个人都很友善。我感觉很自在。
布朗先生：那很重要！我们希望你把这里当家。你有什么问题吗？
梅：暂时没有，谢谢。我只是很高兴能在这里。
布朗先生：太棒了！欢迎来到我们家。

listening.audio: Tom is celebrating his birthday today. He is eleven years old. His friends came to his party. They sang Happy Birthday and he blew out the candles. He got a lot of presents, including a new bicycle.

reading.cn: 今天是汤姆的生日！他十一岁了。他妈妈做了一个大大的巧克力蛋糕。蛋糕上有十一根蜡烛。他的朋友们要来参加生日派对。汤姆很兴奋。他希望能收到一辆新自行车作为礼物。
reading.en: Today is Tom's birthday! He is eleven years old. His mom made a big chocolate cake. There are eleven candles on it. His friends are coming for a birthday party. Tom is very excited. He hopes to get a new bicycle as a present.

reading.cn: 他的朋友们带着五颜六色的礼物来了。他们给汤姆唱《生日快乐歌》。汤姆许了个愿，吹灭了所有蜡烛。大家欢呼起来！然后他们吃蛋糕，玩游戏。汤姆打开了他的礼物。他收到了一些书、一个玩具机器人和一件很酷的新夹克。他喜欢所有的礼物。这是一个美妙的生日！
reading.en: His friends arrive with colorful presents. They sing "Happy Birthday" to Tom. Tom makes a wish and blows out all the candles. Everyone cheers! Then they eat cake and play games. Tom opens his presents. He gets some books, a toy robot, and a cool new jacket. He loves all his gifts. It's a wonderful birthday!

reading.cn: 他妈妈给了他最后一份礼物。那是一个大盒子。汤姆小心翼翼地打开它。“哇！”他喊道。那是一辆全新的自行车！正是他许愿想要的。汤姆高兴极了。“谢谢你，妈妈！这是有史以来最棒的生日！”他说道。
reading.en: His mom gives him one last present. It's a big box. Tom opens it carefully. "Wow!" he shouts. It's a brand new bicycle! Exactly what he wished for. Tom is so happy. "Thank you, Mom! This is the best birthday ever!" he says.

reading.cn: 汤姆的派对在更多的欢乐和笑声中继续着。他觉得自己很幸运能有这么棒的朋友和一个充满爱的家庭。他迫不及待地想明天就骑上他的新自行车。
reading.en: Tom's party continues with more fun and laughter. He feels so lucky to have such wonderful friends and a loving family. He can't wait to ride his new bicycle tomorrow.

grammar.title: I have a/an + [身体部位] + ache / I have a + [症状]
grammar.explain:
这个句型用于表达身体不适或疾病。它可以用来表示“我感到……痛”或“我患有……”。

- 当你感到某个部位疼痛时，可以使用“I have a/an + 身体部位 + ache”。例如，headache（头痛）、stomachache（胃痛）、backache（背痛）。
- 当你表达其他症状时，可以使用“I have a + 症状”。例如，a fever（发烧）、a sore throat（喉咙痛）、a cold（感冒）。

examples.en: I feel sick.
She feels tired.
I don't feel well today.

grammar.title: I feel + [形容词] / I don't feel + [形容词]
grammar.explain:
这个句型用来描述你的感受。你可以用它来表达“我感觉……”或者“我感觉不……”。

- 当你感觉不舒服时，常用形容词有 sick, unwell, tired, dizzy。
- 当你感觉好转时，常用形容词有 better, well, good, great。

output.sample:
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Smith,

Thank you so much for taking care of me yesterday. I really appreciate your kindness. I feel much better now, and the headache is gone! Thank you again for everything.

Best,
Mei

reading.cn: 早上，梅在她的房间里。她感觉不舒服。“哦，我头疼，”她说。史密斯太太来到她的门口。“梅，你还好吗？”她问。梅说：“不，我不好。我头疼，喉咙也疼。我感觉不舒服。”史密斯太太摸了摸梅的额头。“嗯，你还发烧了，”她说，“你需要休息。我去给你拿些药。如果你晚些时候还没好转，我们可以去看医生。”
reading.en: It's morning. Mei is in her room. She doesn't feel well. "Oh, I have a headache," she says. Mrs. Smith comes to her door. "Mei, are you okay?" she asks. Mei says, "No, I'm not. I have a headache and a sore throat. I feel sick." Mrs. Smith touches Mei's forehead. "Hmm, you also have a fever," she says. "You need to rest. I will get you some medicine. If you don't feel better later, we can go to the doctor."

reading.cn: 当天晚些时候，梅吃了药并休息了。她感觉好了一点。史密斯太太来看她。“梅，你感觉怎么样？”她问。梅虚弱地笑了笑。“我感觉好一点了，谢谢你。不再发烧了。”史密斯太太说：“那太好了。记得多喝水。”梅点点头。她很感谢史密斯太太的照顾。
reading.en: Later that day, Mei takes the medicine and rests. She feels a little better. Mrs. Smith checks on her. "How are you feeling, Mei?" she asks. Mei smiles weakly. "I feel a little better, thank you. No more fever." Mrs. Smith says, "That's good. Remember to drink lots of water." Mei nods. She is thankful for Mrs. Smith's care.

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅醒来时头不疼了。她感觉好多了。她下楼，再次感谢史密斯太太。“谢谢您昨天做的一切，史密斯太太。我现在感觉好极了！”史密斯太太笑了笑。“不客气，梅。很高兴你感觉好多了。我们吃早饭吧！”
reading.en: The next morning, Mei wakes up without a headache. She feels much better. She goes downstairs and thanks Mrs. Smith again. "Thank you for everything yesterday, Mrs. Smith. I feel great now!" Mrs. Smith smiles. "You're welcome, Mei. I'm glad you're feeling better. Let's have some breakfast!"

reading.cn: 这是梅第一次在加州生病，她很感谢寄宿家庭的善良。
reading.en: This is Mei's first time being sick in California, and she is grateful for her host family's kindness.

listening.audio: Mei is at the clinic and needs to make a phone call. She asks the receptionist if she can use the phone to call Linda. The receptionist says Linda is busy and asks Mei if she wants to leave a message. Mei decides to leave a message for Linda.

reading.cn: 梅在诊所。她需要给寄宿家庭打电话。她问接待员：“打扰一下，我能用一下电话吗？” 接待员说：“是的，你可以。你想给谁打电话？” 梅回答说：“我想给琳达打电话。请问我能和琳达说话吗？” 接待员拨了号码。一分钟后，她说：“琳达现在很忙。她稍后可以给你回电话。或者你可以留言。” 梅说：“好的，我留言吧。请告诉她梅打过电话了。我正在诊所。”
reading.en: Mei is at the clinic. She needs to call her host family. She asks the receptionist, "Excuse me, can I use the phone?" The receptionist says, "Yes, you can. Who do you want to call?" Mei replies, "I want to call Linda. Can I speak to Linda, please?" The receptionist dials the number. After a minute, she says, "Linda is busy now. She can call you back later. Or you can leave a message." Mei says, "Okay, I'll leave a message. Please tell her Mei called. And I'm at the clinic."

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候琳达给梅回了电话。“嗨，梅，我收到你的留言了。你还好吗？” 梅说：“嗨，琳达。是的，我很好。我只是需要告诉你一些事情。” 琳达问：“什么事？” 梅说：“我今天会晚点回家。我在诊所做了检查。” 琳达说：“好的，没问题。梅，回头见。”
reading.en: Linda calls Mei back later that day. "Hi Mei, I got your message. Are you okay?" Mei says, "Hi Linda. Yes, I'm fine. I just needed to tell you something." Linda asks, "What is it?" Mei says, "I'll be home a little late today. I had a check-up at the clinic." Linda says, "Okay, no problem. See you later, Mei."

reading.cn: 梅在离开诊所前再次感谢了接待员。她很高兴能给琳达打电话，让她知道自己的情况。
reading.en: Mei thanked the receptionist again before she left the clinic. She was glad she could call Linda and let her know about her situation.

reading.cn: 梅到家时，琳达正在等她。“检查怎么样？”琳达问。“一切都很好，谢谢你，琳达。”梅回答。她很高兴见到琳达。
reading.en: When Mei got home, Linda was waiting for her. "How was the check-up?" Linda asked. "Everything is fine, thank you, Linda," Mei replied. She was so happy to see Linda.

reading.cn: 梅和琳达一起吃了晚饭，聊了梅在诊所的一天。梅觉得有这样一个有爱心的寄宿家庭非常幸运。
reading.en: Mei and Linda had dinner together and talked about Mei's day at the clinic. Mei felt very lucky to have such a caring host family.

grammar.title: 动词 “open” 的用法
grammar.explain: 动词 “open” 在本课中特指“开设”账户，它是一个常用动词，有很多不同的意思，但在这里是关于开设一个银行账户。

examples.en: I want to open a bank account.
This bank opens at 9 AM.

reading.cn: 梅几周前刚到美国。今天，她需要开一个银行账户。她走进一栋大楼。里面有很多指示牌。她看到一位女士坐在桌子旁。梅走到她面前。“打扰一下，”梅说，“银行在哪里？”那位女士微笑着说：“你就在银行里！我能帮你什么？”
reading.en: Mei arrived in the US a few weeks ago. Today, she needs to open a bank account. She walks into a big building. There are many signs. She sees a lady at a desk. Mei walks up to her. "Excuse me," Mei says, "where's the bank?" The lady smiles. "You are in the bank! How can I help you?"

Mei feels a little silly but she smiles back. "Oh, I see! I want to open a bank account, please." The lady points to another counter. "Please go to counter three. They will help you there." Mei walks to counter three. She hopes everything goes well.
reading.cn: 梅觉得有点儿傻，但她也回以微笑。“哦，我明白了！我想开一个银行账户，谢谢。”那位女士指向另一个柜台。“请到三号柜台。他们会在那里帮助你。”梅走向三号柜台。她希望一切顺利。
在三号柜台，一位男士迎接梅。“你好！我能帮你什么？”梅说：“我想开一个新账户。”男士问：“你有身份证件和护照吗？”梅拿出她的护照。“有，这是我的护照。”男士给她一张表格让她填写并要求她签名。梅很高兴能开她的第一个美国银行账户。
reading.en: At counter three, a man greets Mei. "Hello! How can I help you?" Mei says, "I'd like to open a new account." The man asks, "Do you have an ID and your passport?" Mei takes out her passport. "Yes, here's my passport." The man gives her a form to fill out and asks her to sign it. Mei is happy to get her first US bank account.

After filling out the form and signing, Mei hands it back. The man reviews it. "Everything looks good! Your account is now open." Mei thanks him. She feels a sense of accomplishment. Now she can manage her money easily in the US.
reading.cn: 填完表格并签名后，梅把它交了回去。男士查看了一下。“一切都很好！你的账户现在已经开好了。”梅感谢他。她感到一种成就感。现在她可以在美国轻松管理她的钱了。

reading.cn: 梅很高兴能找到自己的公寓。她和朋友莉莉一起去看了一些地方。第一套公寓很小，但有一个漂亮的阳台。“这是一居室，”房东说，“月租是1200美元。”梅喜欢明亮的厨房，但她觉得浴室太旧了。第二套公寓有两间卧室和一个大客厅。它不带家具。“我喜欢它，”梅告诉莉莉，“但它离我的工作很远。”他们决定继续找。

"And the rent is $1200 a month." Mei likes the bright kitchen, but she thinks the bathroom is too old. The second apartment has two bedrooms and a big living room. It's unfurnished. "I like it," Mei tells Lily, "but it's far from my work." They decide to keep looking.

reading.cn: 梅说：“我想要一套靠近我办公室的公寓。”莉莉回答说：“是的，那很重要。有一个好的视野也不错！”梅同意道：“当然！我还想要一个现代化的厨房。”她们在网上看了另一套公寓。它有一间卧室，一个新厨房，而且离梅的办公室很近。“租金有点高，”莉莉观察到。“但这很适合你！”梅笑了，“也许这就是我要找的！”
reading.en: Mei says, "I'd like an apartment near my office." Lily replies, "Yes, that's important. And a good view would be nice too!" Mei agrees, "Definitely! And I need a modern kitchen." They look at another apartment online. It has one bedroom, a new kitchen, and it's close to Mei's office. "The rent is a bit high," Lily observes. "But it's perfect for you!" Mei smiles, "Maybe this is the one!"

reading.cn: 梅终于找到了一套她满意的公寓。它有一间卧室和一个宽敞的客厅。厨房是新的，还有一个可以俯瞰城市景色的小阳台。它离她的办公室也很近。租金比她预期的要高一点，但她觉得很值得。当她签下租约时，她感到非常高兴和兴奋。
reading.en: Mei finally finds an apartment she loves. It has one bedroom and a spacious living room. The kitchen is new, and there's a small balcony with a city view. It's also very close to her office. The rent is a little more than she wanted, but she feels it's worth it. When she signs the lease, she feels very happy and excited.

reading.cn: 梅搬进了她的新公寓。她的朋友们帮她搬家具。她很高兴拥有自己的空间。她决定下周末邀请莉莉来参加乔迁派对。梅迫不及待地想装饰她的新家。
reading.en: Mei moves into her new apartment. Her friends help her with the furniture. She is very happy to have her own space. She decides to invite Lily over for a housewarming party next weekend. Mei can't wait to decorate her new home.

reading.en: Mei and Anna walk into a cozy restaurant. It's dinner time, and the restaurant is busy. Mei looks around. "A table for two, please," Anna says to the waiter. The waiter smiles. "Follow me, please." He leads them to a small table by the window. "Here are your menus. I'll be back to take your order in a few minutes." Mei looks at the menu. "Everything looks delicious!" she says.

reading.cn: 过了一会儿，服务员回来了。“你们准备好点餐了吗？”他问道。安娜点了一份意大利面，梅点了一份鸡肉沙拉。她们还分享了一杯柠檬水。她们愉快地用餐并开心地聊天。用餐结束后，安娜要了账单。“这是一顿美妙的晚餐，梅！”她说。梅同意道：“是的，确实是！谢谢你，安娜！”
reading.en: After a while, the waiter comes back. "Are you ready to order?" he asks. Anna orders a pasta dish, and Mei orders a chicken salad. They also share a lemonade. They enjoy their meal and chat happily. When they finish, Anna asks for the bill. "That was a wonderful dinner, Mei!" she says. Mei agrees, "Yes, it was! Thank you, Anna!"

reading.cn: 安娜去收银台付款。她把信用卡递给收银员。收银员处理了付款。“谢谢！祝您有个愉快的夜晚！”收银员说。安娜和梅走出餐厅，感到饱足而愉快。
reading.en: Anna goes to the cashier to pay. She hands her credit card to the cashier. The cashier processes the payment. "Thank you! Have a good night!" the cashier says. Anna and Mei walk out of the restaurant, feeling full and happy.

As they walk, Mei says, "I really liked the chicken salad. And the lemonade was so refreshing!" Anna smiles, "I'm glad you enjoyed it. We should explore more restaurants in this city!" Mei's eyes light up. "Absolutely!"

reading.cn: 这是梅在美国的第一个万圣节。她的寄宿家庭布朗一家非常兴奋。布朗太太帮梅选择了一套女巫服装。“你看起来很棒！”布朗太太说。布朗先生和汤姆用南瓜和吓人的蜘蛛网装饰了房子。晚上，许多穿着奇装异服的孩子来到他们家门口。“不给糖就捣蛋！”他们喊道。布朗一家给了他们很多糖果。然后，梅、汤姆和布朗先生在街区里去“不给糖就捣蛋”。梅一开始有点害羞，但很快她就享受其中了。她得到了很多糖果！“万圣节真好玩！”梅说。
reading.en: It was Mei's first Halloween in America. Her host family, the Browns, were very excited. Mrs. Brown helped Mei choose a witch costume. "You look good!" Mrs. Brown said. Mr. Brown and Tom decorated the house with pumpkins and spooky spider webs. In the evening, many kids in amazing costumes came to their door. "Trick or treat!" they shouted. The Browns gave them lots of candy. Then, Mei, Tom, and Mr. Brown went trick-or-treating in the neighborhood. Mei felt a little shy at first, but soon she enjoyed it. She got a lot of candy! "Halloween is fun!" Mei said.

reading.cn: 梅听到门铃响了。她向外看去，看到门口有一个小幽灵。她的寄宿妈妈，布朗太太笑了。“哦，万圣节到了！”她说。布朗太太打开了门。“不给糖就捣蛋！”小幽灵喊道。布朗太太把一些糖果放进了幽灵的篮子里。梅看着。后来，布朗太太帮梅穿上她的女巫服装。“走吧，梅！是时候去要糖了！”梅的寄宿哥哥汤姆说。梅有点紧张但很兴奋。他们绕着街区走。梅看到许多穿着不同服装的孩子。他们去了很多房子，得到了很多糖果。梅想，“这太有趣了！”
reading.en: Mei heard a doorbell ring. She looked outside and saw a little ghost at the door. Her host mother, Mrs. Brown, smiled. "Oh, it’s Halloween!" she said. Mrs. Brown opened the door. "Trick or treat!" shouted the little ghost. Mrs. Brown put some candy in the ghost's basket. Mei watched. Later, Mrs. Brown helped Mei put on her witch costume. "Let's go, Mei! It's time to trick-or-treat!" said Tom, Mei's host brother. Mei was a little nervous but excited. They walked around the neighborhood. Mei saw many kids in different costumes. They went to many houses and got a lot of candy. Mei thought, "This is so much fun!"

reading.cn: 梅和布朗一家在家。那天是10月31日。布朗太太把一个大南瓜放在桌子上。“我们可以雕刻它，”她说。梅的寄宿哥哥汤姆非常擅长雕刻。他在南瓜上雕刻了一张可怕的脸。“哇，真吓人！”梅说。后来，布朗先生挂了一些假蜘蛛网。房子看起来像一个鬼屋！梅帮布朗太太在门边放了几碗糖果。“今晚，许多孩子会来要糖，”布朗太太解释道。梅很高兴能庆祝她的第一个万圣节。
reading.en: Mei was at home with the Browns. It was October 31st. Mrs. Brown put a big pumpkin on the table. "We can carve it," she said. Tom, Mei's host brother, was very good at carving. He made a scary face on the pumpkin. "Wow, it's spooky!" Mei said. Later, Mr. Brown put up some fake spider webs. The house looked like a haunted house! Mei helped Mrs. Brown put bowls of candy by the door. "Tonight, many children will come to trick-or-treat," Mrs. Brown explained. Mei was excited to celebrate her first Halloween.

reading.cn: 梅看到她的寄宿妹妹莉莉穿上了一件公主服装。“你要去参加派对吗？”梅问道。莉莉笑了。“不，梅！今天是万圣节！我要去要糖！”梅对万圣节了解不多。莉莉解释说：“孩子们穿上戏服去别人家。他们说‘不给糖就捣蛋！’然后人们会给他们糖果。”梅觉得这听起来很有趣。后来，莉莉帮梅找到了一块简单的床单穿上。“你可以扮鬼！”莉莉说。梅穿着床单觉得有点傻，但她很高兴尝试新事物。他们一起走进了社区。
reading.en: Mei saw her host sister, Lily, putting on a princess costume. "Are you going to a party?" Mei asked. Lily laughed. "No, Mei! It's Halloween! I'm going trick-or-treating!" Mei didn't know much about Halloween. Lily explained, "Kids wear costumes and go to houses. They say 'trick or treat!' and people give them candy." Mei thought it sounded interesting. Later, Lily helped Mei find a simple sheet to wear. "You can be a ghost!" Lily said. Mei felt a little silly in the sheet, but she was excited to try something new. They went out into the neighborhood together.

reading.cn: 晚饭后，梅正在和她的寄宿家庭妈妈苏珊聊天。

reading.en: Mei loves movies! Today, her host family, the Smiths, are taking her to see a new movie. "What kind of movie is it?" Mei asks. "It's an action movie with lots of special effects," says Mrs. Smith. At the movie theater, Mr. Smith buys the tickets. "Two adults and one student, please," he says. Then, they go to the snack bar. "What would you like, Mei?" Mr. Smith asks. Mei looks at the menu. "I'd like a medium popcorn and a large soda, please," she says. They find their seats in row G. The movie starts soon. Mei is very excited!
reading.cn: 梅很喜欢看电影！今天，她的寄宿家庭史密斯一家带她去看一部新电影。“是什么类型的电影？”梅问道。“是一部动作片，有很多特效。”史密斯夫人说。在电影院，史密斯先生买了票。“两张成人票和一张学生票，谢谢。”他说。然后，他们去了小吃吧。“梅，你想要什么？”史密斯先生问。梅看着菜单。“我想要一份中杯爆米花和一杯大杯汽水，谢谢。”她说。他们在G排找到了自己的座位。电影很快就开始了。梅非常兴奋！
梅非常享受这部电影。演员们很棒，故事也很精彩。她又笑又叫，有时甚至有点害怕。电影期间，她吃完了所有的爆米花，喝了一半的汽水。电影结束后，梅告诉史密斯一家：“那真是一部很棒的电影！谢谢你们带我来。”史密斯夫人笑着说：“不客气，梅。我们很高兴你喜欢。”梅感到很开心，并期待着下次和史密斯一家一起看电影的夜晚。
reading.en: Mei enjoys the movie very much. The actors are amazing, and the story is exciting. She laughs, she cheers, and she even gets a little scared sometimes. During the movie, she finishes all her popcorn and drinks half of her soda. After the movie, Mei tells the Smiths, "That was a fantastic movie! Thank you for taking me." Mrs. Smith smiles, "You're welcome, Mei. We're glad you enjoyed it." Mei feels happy and looks forward to her next movie night with the Smiths.

Mei learns a lot from this experience. She practices ordering food at the snack bar and communicating with her host family about the movie. She also learns new English words related to movies and theaters. Most importantly, she feels more comfortable and confident in her new environment. She realizes that cultural experiences like watching a movie are not only fun but also great opportunities to improve her English.
reading.cn: 梅从这次经历中学到了很多。她练习在小吃吧点餐，并与寄宿家庭交流电影相关内容。她还学到了与电影院相关的新英语单词。最重要的是，她在新环境中感到更自在和自信。她意识到，像看电影这样的文化体验不仅有趣，也是提高英语的好机会。
第二天，梅决定给她的朋友莉莉讲讲电影。“你不会相信它有多棒！”梅在电话里对莉莉说。“特效令人难以置信，爆米花也很好吃！我们下次应该一起去。”莉莉热情地同意道：“当然！我们应该看什么电影？”梅笑着说：“咱们这周末查查放映时间吧！”
reading.en: The next day, Mei decides to tell her friend, Lily, about the movie. "You won't believe how great it was!" Mei says to Lily over the phone. "The special effects were incredible, and the popcorn was delicious! We should go together next time." Lily agrees enthusiastically, "Definitely! What movie should we see?" Mei laughs, "Let's check the showtimes this weekend!"

reading.cn: 梅在她的房间里。纽约现在是早上。她想和在北京的奶奶说话。她说：“我要和奶奶视频通话。”梅查了一下时差。“嗯，北京现在是深夜。奶奶现在肯定在睡觉。”她决定明天早上再打。“我明天一早会打过去，”她想。“奶奶会很高兴见到我的！”
reading.en: Mei is in her room. It's morning in New York. She wants to talk to her grandma in Beijing. "I'm going to FaceTime grandma," she says. Mei checks the time difference. "Hmm, it's late night in Beijing. Grandma is sleeping now." She decides to call tomorrow morning. "I'll call early tomorrow," she thinks. "Grandma will be happy to see me!"

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅早早地醒了。她喝了点水，然后拿起手机。“好的，北京现在是早上，”她想。她点开FaceTime图标。电话响了。“喂？”奶奶说。梅笑了。“奶奶，你好！你怎么样？”
reading.en: The next morning, Mei wakes up early. She drinks some water and then picks up her phone. "Okay, it's morning in Beijing now," she thinks. She taps the FaceTime icon. The phone rings. "Hello?" says grandma. Mei smiles. "Hi, grandma! How are you?"

Grandma is very happy. "Mei! It's good to see you!" she says. "I'm fine, thank you. What are you doing?" Mei tells her about her day and her new friends. She shows grandma her room. They talk for a long time. Later, Mei says, "I have to go now, grandma. I have a class soon." Grandma says, "Okay, talk to you later, Mei. Take care!" Mei feels happy after talking to her grandma.
reading.cn: 奶奶非常高兴。“梅！很高兴见到你！”她说。“我很好，谢谢你。你在做什么呢？”梅告诉奶奶她的一天和她的新朋友。她给奶奶看了她的房间。她们聊了很久。后来，梅说：“奶奶，我得走了。我很快要上课了。”奶奶说：“好的，梅，我们回头再聊。保重！”梅和奶奶聊完天后感到很开心。
奶奶经常说：“听到你的声音真好。”梅喜欢给她打电话。她想念她在北京的家人。
reading.en: Grandma often says, "It's nice to hear your voice." Mei likes to call her. She misses her family in Beijing.

examples.en: I am thankful for my family.

reading.cn: 梅在美国的第一个感恩节非常特别。她的寄宿家庭李家人聚在家里。李太太做了一只大火鸡和许多其他美味的菜肴。李先生在电视上看感恩节游行。梅帮忙摆桌子。大家坐下来吃大餐。他们都手拉手，说出自己感恩的事情。梅说：“我感谢我在这里的新家人。”晚饭后，他们吃了南瓜派。梅感到很高兴，也很感谢能和他们在一起。
reading.en: Mei's first Thanksgiving Day in America was very special. Her host family, the Lees, gathered at their house. Mrs. Lee cooked a big turkey and many other delicious dishes. Mr. Lee watched the Thanksgiving parade on TV. Mei helped set the table. Everyone sat down for the big meal. They all held hands and said what they were thankful for. Mei said, "I am thankful for my new family here." After dinner, they ate pumpkin pie. Mei felt happy and thankful to be with them.

reading.cn: 梅喜欢过节！感恩节现在是她最喜欢的节日。她学到了很多美国传统。她甚至帮忙做了一些蔓越莓酱。明年，她希望能和李家人再次一起庆祝感恩节。
reading.en: Mei loves holidays! Thanksgiving is her favorite now. She learned a lot about American traditions. She even helped make some cranberry sauce. Next year, she hopes to celebrate Thanksgiving again with the Lees.

reading.cn: 梅：这火鸡真大！李太太：是的，这是感恩节的传统。我们总会吃一顿大餐。梅：闻起来真香！李太太：谢谢你，梅。今年你感恩什么呢？梅：我感谢您和李先生，以及我的新家。
reading.en: Mei: This turkey is so big! Mrs. Lee: Yes, it's a Thanksgiving tradition. We always have a big meal. Mei: It smells delicious! Mrs. Lee: Thank you, Mei. What are you thankful for this year? Mei: I am thankful for you and Mr. Lee, and for my new home.

reading.cn: 李先生：晚饭后，我们看会橄榄球。梅：这也是感恩节传统吗？李先生：是的！家人、美食、橄榄球！
reading.en: Mr. Lee: After dinner, we'll watch some football. Mei: Is that a Thanksgiving tradition too? Mr. Lee: Yes, it is! Family, food, and football!

reading.cn: 梅的寄宿家庭为她在洛杉矶的周末提出了许多建议。“星期六，我们可以去博物馆，”史密斯太太说。“或者我们可以去海滩。你更想做什么？”梅想了想。“我想去海滩，”她说。“我爱大海。”星期天，史密斯先生问：“你想去山区徒步旅行，还是想在家放松？”梅笑了笑。“我想在家放松，”她回答。“这个周末就是用来放松的。”
reading.en: Mei's host family suggested many things for her weekend in LA. "On Saturday, we can go to a museum," Mrs. Smith said. "Or we can go to the beach. What would you like to do?" Mei thought about it. "I'd like to go to the beach," she said. "I love the ocean." On Sunday, Mr. Smith asked, "Do you want to go hiking in the mountains, or would you like to just relax at home?" Mei smiled. "I'd like to relax at home," she replied. "This weekend is for relaxing."

reading.en: After Thanksgiving, Mei was back in her host family's living room. Sarah, her host sister, asked her, "Hey Mei, what did you watch last night?" Mei thought for a moment and said, "I watched a really interesting show about cooking. It was a Thanksgiving special. What about you, Sarah?"
reading.cn: 感恩节过后，梅回到了寄宿家庭的客厅。她的寄宿姐妹莎拉问她：“嘿，梅，你昨晚看了什么？”梅想了想说：“我看了一个很有趣的烹饪节目。那是一个感恩节特别节目。你呢，莎拉？”
莎拉笑了。“我昨晚和家人看了一部电影。那是一部喜剧。我们都笑得很开心！那是我最喜欢的电影之一。我爸爸平时看橄榄球，但昨晚他跟我们一起看了电影。”梅点点头。“听起来很有趣！也许下次我们可以一起看电影。”
reading.en: Sarah smiled. "I watched a movie with my family. It was a comedy. We all laughed a lot! It's one of my favorite movies. My dad usually watches football, but last night he watched the movie with us." Mei nodded. "Sounds fun! Maybe next time we can watch a movie together."

Later, Mei planned to tell her friend Li about the shows. "Li, I watched a cooking show last night. What did you watch? Maybe you watched something good on TV too!" She was excited to share her experience.
reading.cn: 后来，梅打算把这些节目告诉她的朋友丽。“丽，我昨晚看了一个烹饪节目。你看了什么？也许你也在电视上看了什么好节目！”她很高兴能分享她的经历。
梅在网上找到了一份美国电视节目列表。她看到了许多不同类型的节目：电视剧、纪录片，甚至还有更多的烹饪节目。她心想：“有好多节目可以看啊！”
reading.en: Mei found a list of American TV shows online. She saw many different types: dramas, documentaries, and even more cooking shows. She thought, "There are so many shows to watch!"

reading.en: It's a cold morning. Mei is meeting her friend, Lily, at the mall. Lily arrives first. "Hi, Mei! You look great today!" Lily says. Mei smiles. "Thanks, Lily! You too. Is that a new coat?" Lily nods. "Yes, it is! I bought it yesterday. Do you like it?" Mei touches the soft fabric. "Yes, I do! It looks very warm. And I like your new shoes too. Where did you get them?" Lily laughs. "Let's go shopping! I can show you the store." Mei is happy to spend time with her friend.
reading.cn: 这是一个寒冷的早晨。梅正在商场和她的朋友莉莉见面。莉莉先到了。“嗨，梅！你今天看起来真棒！”莉莉说。梅笑了。“谢谢，莉莉！你也是。那是件新外套吗？”莉莉点点头。“是的，是新的！我昨天买的。你喜欢吗？”梅摸了摸柔软的面料。“是的，我喜欢！它看起来很暖和。我也喜欢你的新鞋。你在哪里买的？”莉莉笑了。“我们去购物吧！我可以带你看看那家店。”梅很高兴能和她的朋友在一起。
梅和莉莉一起享受着她们的一天。她们在店里看着很多不同的商品。梅找到了一条漂亮的围巾。“你觉得这条围巾戴在我身上好看吗？”梅问。莉莉笑了。“是的，很好看！”梅很高兴有这样一个好朋友。
reading.en: Mei and Lily are enjoying their day together. They are looking at many different items in the store. Mei finds a beautiful scarf. "Do you think this scarf looks good on me?" Mei asks. Lily smiles. "Yes, it does!" Mei feels happy to have such a good friend.

reading.cn: 午餐时，她们在一家咖啡馆停了下来。“我真高兴我们今天来购物了，”梅说。“我也是！和你在一起总是很有趣，”莉莉回答。她们边说边笑，分享着故事，并为下一次见面做计划。她们真是好朋友。
reading.en: At lunchtime, they stop at a cafe. "I'm so glad we came shopping today," Mei says. "Me too! It's always fun with you," Lily replies. They talk and laugh, sharing stories and making plans for next time. They are truly good friends.

As the day ends, Mei feels warm inside. Not just from her new scarf, but from the warmth of friendship. "See you soon, Lily!" Mei says. "Bye, Mei!" Lily waves. Mei walks home, already looking forward to their next shopping trip.
reading.cn: 一天结束时，梅心里感到很温暖。不仅仅是因为她的新围巾，更是因为友谊的温暖。“莉莉，回头见！”梅说。“再见，梅！”莉莉挥手。梅走回家，已经开始期待她们的下一次购物之旅了。

grammar.explain: “Have a good trip!” 是一种常见的告别语，用来祝别人旅途愉快。Good 可以替换成其他形容词，比如 exciting, wonderful 等，使祝福更具体。这种句型通常用于送别即将旅行的朋友或家人。

grammar.explain: “See (someone) off” 的意思是“给（某人）送行”。这个短语强调陪伴某人到其出发点，如机场、车站等，表达告别之情。
grammar.title: See (someone) off

reading.en: It's Saturday morning. Tom is going on a ski trip with his school. Mei is at the bus stop to see him off. Tom has a big backpack. Mei says, "Have a good trip, Tom!" Tom smiles and says, "Thanks, Mei! See you next week." The bus arrives. Tom gets on the bus. Mei waves goodbye. She hopes he has an exciting journey.

reading.en: Mei: Have an exciting trip! Don't forget to send me some photos.

reading.cn: 汤姆：会的！你也过一个愉快的周末。再见，梅！

grammar.explain: 现在完成时用来表示从过去某个时间点开始，一直持续到现在或对现在有影响的动作或状态。当我们需要强调持续的时间长度时，常用 "for" 加上一段时间；当我们需要强调开始的时间点时，常用 "since" 加上一个具体时间点。

examples.cn: 梅已经在美国三个月了。
examples.en: Mei has been in the U.S. for three months.
I have studied English since 2020.

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect) + for/since

grammar.explain: 一般过去时用来描述在过去某个时间点发生并结束的动作或事件。常常与表示过去时间的词一起使用，如 "ago", "yesterday", "last week" 等。
grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past)

examples.en: She arrived three months ago.
When she first came, everything was new.
examples.cn: 她刚来的时候，一切都很新鲜。

examples.en: Now, Mei feels more comfortable.
She still misses her family.

grammar.title: 一般现在时 (Simple Present)
grammar.explain: 一般现在时用来描述现在的事实、习惯性动作或普遍真理。它也可以用来描述现在持续的状态。

reading.cn: 梅已经在美国三个月了。她是三个月前到的。她刚来的时候，一切都很新鲜。她有点紧张，但也感到兴奋。现在，梅感觉更自在了。她交了新朋友，也学到了很多美国文化。她仍然想念家人，但她也为自己的进步感到自豪。她正在适应她的新生活。
reading.en: Mei has been in the U.S. for three months. She arrived three months ago. When she first came, everything was new. She felt a little nervous, but also excited. Now, Mei feels more comfortable. She has made new friends and is learning a lot about American culture. She still misses her family, but she is also proud of her progress. She is getting used to her new life.

output.sample: I have been in the U.S. for three months now. When I first arrived, everything was new and a little bit challenging. I felt nervous sometimes. But now, I feel more comfortable. I am making new friends and learning about American culture. I still miss my family, but I am also very proud of my progress. I am getting used to my new life here.
output.cn: 想象你就是梅。写一小段话，描述你在美国生活三个月的经历。你刚来的时候是怎样的？你现在感觉如何？你学到了什么？
output.prompt: Imagine you are Mei. Write a short paragraph about your experience of living in the U.S. for three months. What was it like when you first came? How do you feel now? What have you learned?

grammar.title: 表示物体位置的介词：on / under
grammar.explain: 在英语中，我们使用介词 'on' 和 'under' 来描述物体的位置。'On' 表示“在……上面”，'under' 表示“在……下面”。它们通常放在动词 'be' 之后。

examples.en: The cat is on the table.
The book is on the chair.
The dog is under the table.

grammar.title: 简单陈述句：主语 + be 动词 + 介词短语

grammar.explain: 当我们要说明某物在哪里时，常用的句型是“主语 + be 动词 + 介词短语”。be 动词会根据主语的人称和单复数进行变化（如 is, are）。

vocab.example: Mei wants to send a package to China.

reading.cn: 梅在邮局。快到圣诞节了，她想寄一个包裹给在中国的家人。她走到柜台前。“你好，我想把这个包裹寄到中国。”梅对工作人员说。工作人员微笑着说：“好的，请问能看一下地址吗？”梅给他看包裹。“还有你的名字？”梅说：“梅。”“那个怎么拼？”工作人员问。“M-E-I。”她拼写道。“谢谢。你需要填写这张海关申报表。”梅拿着表格和笔开始填写。
reading.en: Mei is at the Post Office. It's almost Christmas, and she wants to send a package to her family in China. She walks to the counter. "Hello, I want to send this package to China," Mei says to the clerk. The clerk smiles, "Okay, can I see the address, please?" Mei shows him the package. "And your name, please?" Mei says, "Mei." "How do you spell that?" the clerk asks. "M-E-I," she spells. "Thank you. You need to fill out this customs form." Mei takes the form and a pen. She starts to write.

reading.cn: 梅填完了表格。工作人员看了一眼。“一切都很好。”他说。“费用是25.50美元。”梅付了钱。“什么时候能到中国？”她问。“国际包裹通常需要两到三周。”他回答道。“谢谢您！”梅愉快地说。她很高兴能给家人寄圣诞包裹。
reading.en: Mei finishes filling out the form. The clerk looks at it. "Everything looks good," he says. "The cost is $25.50." Mei pays him. "When will it arrive in China?" she asks. "It usually takes about two to three weeks for international packages," he replies. "Thank you!" Mei says cheerfully. She feels happy to send her family a Christmas package.

reading.cn: 梅觉得很开心。她迫不及待地想让家人收到圣诞包裹。里面有很多给他们的礼物和卡片。她希望他们会喜欢。
reading.en: Mei feels happy. She can't wait for her family to receive the Christmas package. It has a lot of gifts and cards for them. She hopes they will like it.

reading.cn: 梅走出邮局，查看手机。她看到寄宿家庭妈妈发来的信息，写着“你寄包裹了吗？我们很快在家见！我们在做圣诞饼干呢！”梅笑了。她回复道：“是的，我寄了！很快见！饼干听起来太棒了！”
reading.en: Mei walks out of the post office and checks her phone. She sees a message from her host mother, saying "Did you send the package? See you soon at home! We are making cookies for Christmas!" Mei smiles. She replies, "Yes, I did! See you soon! Cookies sound great!"

grammar.explain: 在超市购物时，我们经常需要询问商品的具体位置。最常见的表达是 “Excuse me, where can I find…?” （打扰一下，请问…在哪里？）或者 “Where is…?”（…在哪里？）。回答时，可以用 “It’s in aisle…” （它在…通道）或 “It’s next to…” （它在…旁边）来指明位置。

grammar.title: Making a polite request: “I'd like...”

grammar.explain: “I'd like...” 是 “I would like...” 的缩写，表示“我想要…”，是一种非常客气、自然的表达方式，比直接说 “I want…” 更委婉有礼。在点餐、购物等场景中非常常用。

examples.en: I'd like a coffee, please.
I'd like two coffees, please.
I'd like a cup of tea, please.

grammar.explain: 在咖啡店或其他地方点餐时，我们可以使用“I'd like...”这个句型，表示“我想要……”。这是一个礼貌的表达。在请求的最后加上“please”会让你的话语更客气。

reading.cn: 新年第一天。梅和她的朋友丽娜在一家咖啡店。外面有点冷。梅走到柜台点单。咖啡师微笑着说：“您想点什么？”梅想了一下，说：“两杯咖啡，谢谢。”咖啡师问：“还需要别的吗？”梅摇了摇头。“不用了，谢谢。”她付了钱，等着咖啡。丽娜在桌边等着。“您的咖啡！”咖啡师说。梅接过咖啡并向她道谢。她拿着两杯热咖啡走回丽娜身边。这是新年美好的开始。
reading.en: It's New Year's Day. Mei and her friend, Lina, are at a coffee shop. It's a little cold outside. Mei goes to the counter to order. The barista smiles. "What can I get for you?" she asks. Mei thinks for a moment. "Two coffees, please," Mei says. The barista asks, "Anything else?" Mei shakes her head. "No, thank you." She pays and waits for the coffees. Lina waits at a table. "Here are your coffees!" the barista says. Mei takes them and thanks her. She walks back to Lina with the two warm coffees. It's a nice start to the new year.

reading.en: It's Christmas morning. Mei wakes up early. The house is quiet. She goes to the kitchen. Her host mom, Mrs. Smith, is already there. "Good morning, Mei!" says Mrs. Smith. "Would you like some coffee or tea?" Mei smiles. "Good morning, Mrs. Smith. I prefer tea, please. A hot tea." Mrs. Smith pours a cup of hot tea for Mei. "Here you go. Merry Christmas!" reading.en: Mei: Can I ask a question? What does 'put away' mean? Tom: It means to put something back in its correct place. For example, 'Please put away your clothes.' Mei: Ah, I see! So, after drying the dishes, we put them away in the cupboard. Tom: Exactly!

reading.cn: 梅正在一家玩具店里，为她的妹妹挑选生日礼物。她看到了一个漂亮的玩偶。“这个太完美了！”梅心想。她走到收银台。收银员微笑着说：“你好！准备好结账了吗？”梅点点头。“是的，我准备好了。多少钱？”收银员说：“25美元。您想用现金还是刷卡支付？”梅停顿了一下。她通常用卡，但她今天带了些现金。“现金支付，谢谢。”梅说。她把钱递给收银员。收银员把玩偶和收据递给她。“谢谢！祝您愉快！”梅愉快地说。
reading.en: Mei is at a toy store, looking for a birthday gift for her younger sister. She finds a beautiful doll. "This is perfect!" Mei thinks. She walks to the counter. The cashier smiles and says, "Hello! Are you ready to check out?" Mei nods. "Yes, I am. How much is it?" The cashier says, "It's $25. Would you like to pay with cash or card?" Mei pauses for a moment. She usually uses her card, but she has some cash today. "Cash, please," Mei says. She gives the cashier the money. The cashier gives her the doll and a receipt. "Thank you! Have a great day!" Mei says cheerfully.

reading.cn: 后来，梅遇到了她的朋友莉莉。“我给我妹妹买了一件礼物！”梅说。莉莉问：“哦，真的吗？你买了什么？”梅给她看那个玩偶。“这个玩偶！它太可爱了。”莉莉说：“那是一件可爱的礼物！你打折了吗？”梅摇摇头。“不，今天没有。但价格很公道。我用现金支付的。”莉莉回答说：“现金很好。有时候商店对现金支付会提供特价。”梅笑了笑。“很高兴知道！”
reading.en: Later, Mei meets her friend Lily. "I bought a gift for my sister!" Mei says. Lily asks, "Oh, really? What did you get?" Mei shows her the doll. "This doll! It's so cute." Lily says, "That's a lovely gift! Did you get a discount?" Mei shakes her head. "No, not today. But the price was fair. I paid in cash." Lily replies, "Cash is good. Sometimes stores offer special prices for cash payments." Mei smiles. "Good to know!"

reading.cn: 梅回到家时，她的妹妹小丽看到了礼物。“哇！一个新玩偶！谢谢你，梅！”小丽紧紧抱住梅。梅很高兴看到妹妹的兴奋。“不客气，小丽。生日快乐！”梅觉得挑选礼物很有趣，尤其是当她看到妹妹开心的时候。
reading.en: When Mei gets home, her sister, Xiao Li, sees the gift. "Wow! A new doll! Thank you, Mei!" Xiao Li hugs Mei tightly. Mei is happy to see her sister's excitement. "You're welcome, Xiao Li. Happy birthday!" Mei thinks picking out gifts is fun, especially when she sees her sister happy.

reading.cn: 梅把她的购物经历告诉了妈妈。“妈妈，我给小丽买了一件礼物！这次我用现金支付的。”妈妈微笑着说：“那太好了，梅。同时拥有现金和刷卡两种选择总是好的。”梅表示同意。“是的，是这样。那家店有很多好东西。我看到一条漂亮的围巾，但我只买了那个玩偶。”妈妈说：“也许下次你可以买那条围巾。”梅咯咯地笑了。她喜欢买礼物。说。
reading.en: Mei tells her mom about her shopping trip. "Mom, I bought a gift for Xiao Li! I paid with cash this time." Her mom smiles, "That's great, Mei. It's always good to have both options, cash or card." Mei agrees. "Yes, it is. The store had many nice things. I saw a beautiful scarf, but I only bought the doll." Her mom says, "Maybe next time, you can get the scarf." Mei giggles. She loves shopping for gifts.

output.sample: Hey Lily! Guess what? I bought a super cute doll for Xiao Li's birthday today! It was $25. I paid with cash this time, which felt nice. She's going to love it!

reading.cn: 梅去了邮局。她有一个小包裹要寄给她的妹妹。她的妹妹住在海外。“早上好！”梅对职员说。“我想寄这个包裹。”职员微笑着说：“没问题。你需要邮票吗？”梅回答说：“是的，谢谢。我还需要填写一张海关申报单。”职员给了她表格和一支笔。梅仔细地写下了她妹妹的地址和她自己的地址。
reading.en: Mei went to the post office. She had a small package for her sister. Her sister lives overseas. "Good morning!" Mei said to the clerk. "I'd like to mail this package, please." The clerk smiled. "No problem. Do you need any stamps?" Mei replied, "Yes, please. And I also need to fill out a customs form." The clerk gave her the form and a pen. Mei carefully wrote her sister's address and her own.

reading.cn: 梅填完后，她把表格和包裹交给职员。职员称了包裹的重量。他说：“一共是25.50美元。”梅用信用卡支付了。“下周前能到吗？”梅问。职员确认说：“应该可以。”梅谢过他，离开了邮局，很高兴她的妹妹很快就能收到她的礼物。
reading.en: After Mei finished, she handed the form and the package back to the clerk. The clerk weighed the package. "That will be $25.50," he said. Mei paid with her credit card. "Will it arrive by next week?" Mei asked. "It should," the clerk confirmed. Mei thanked him and left the post office, happy that her sister would soon receive her gift.

reading.cn: 一周后，梅的妹妹莉莉打开了包裹。里面有一条漂亮的手工围巾和一张卡片。卡片上写着：“亲爱的莉莉，想念你！希望你喜欢这条围巾。爱你的，梅。”莉莉笑了。她立刻戴上了围巾。围巾又温暖又柔软，就像梅的拥抱一样。她感到很开心，也更想念她的姐姐了。
reading.en: Mei's sister, Lily, opened the package a week later. Inside, there was a beautiful handmade scarf and a card. The card read, "Dear Lily, Thinking of you! Hope you like the scarf. Love, Mei." Lily smiled. She immediately put on the scarf. It was warm and soft, just like Mei's hugs. She felt happy and missed her sister even more.

reading.cn: 莉莉决定立即给梅打电话。“梅！包裹到了！我爱这条围巾！太谢谢你了！”莉莉喊道。梅听到这个消息很高兴。“不客气，莉莉！你喜欢就好。我想你！”她们聊了很久，分享着故事和欢笑。即使她们相距遥远，邮寄的包裹也让她们的心更近了。
reading.en: Lily decided to call Mei right away. "Mei! The package arrived! I love the scarf! Thank you so much!" Lily exclaimed. Mei was happy to hear that. "You're welcome, Lily! I'm glad you like it. I miss you!" They talked for a long time, sharing stories and laughter. Even though they were far apart, the mailed package brought them closer.

reading.cn: 梅正在厨房帮琳达的忙。琳达有一个漂亮的老式茶杯。那是她最喜欢的。梅想帮忙洗它，但突然，砰！杯子掉了下来，摔成了许多碎片。梅感觉很糟糕。“哦，不！”她想。她转向琳达。“琳达，我真的很抱歉。我打破了你的杯子。这是一个意外。”琳达看到了碎片。她看着梅。“没关系，梅。别担心。这是一个意外。这种事时有发生。我们一起清理吧。”梅感觉好了一点。“谢谢你，琳达。下次我会更小心的。”
reading.en: Mei was helping Linda in the kitchen. Linda had a beautiful, old teacup. It was her favorite. Mei wanted to help wash it, but suddenly, *crash*! The cup fell and broke into many pieces. Mei felt terrible. "Oh, no!" she thought. She turned to Linda. "Linda, I'm really sorry. I broke your cup. It was an accident." Linda saw the broken pieces. She looked at Mei. "It's okay, Mei. Don't worry. It was an accident. These things happen. Let's clean it up together." Mei felt a little better. "Thank you, Linda. I'll be more careful next time."

reading.cn: 后来，琳达告诉梅，“那个杯子是我奶奶传下来的。它承载了很多回忆。”梅又感到很难过。“我非常抱歉，琳达。我真的是。我能做些什么吗？”琳达笑了笑，“你可以帮我找一个新喜欢的杯子！没有，开玩笑的。别担心了。只是对其他东西小心点，好吗？”梅点点头，“是的，我会的。谢谢你的理解。”
reading.en: Later, Linda told Mei, "That cup was from my grandmother. It had a lot of memories." Mei felt bad again. "I'm so sorry, Linda. I really am. Is there anything I can do?" Linda smiled, "You can help me find a new favorite cup! No, just kidding. Don't worry about it. Just be careful with other things, okay?" Mei nodded, "Yes, I will. Thank you for being so understanding."

reading.cn: 梅松了一口气。琳达非常善良。她学到，当你犯错误时，诚实和真诚的道歉很重要。当然，小心谨慎也总是好的！
reading.en: Mei felt relieved. Linda was very kind. She learned that honesty and a sincere apology are important when you make a mistake. And of course, being careful is always a good idea!

reading.cn: 从那以后，梅总是记得要格外小心，尤其是在琳达的厨房里。她甚至买了一个小礼物送给琳达作为感谢，一个漂亮的新马克杯。琳达很欣赏这个举动，她们继续享受在一起的时光。
reading.en: After that, Mei always remembered to be extra careful, especially in Linda's kitchen. She even bought Linda a small gift as a thank you, a lovely new mug. Linda appreciated the gesture and they continued to enjoy their time together.

grammar.explain: 当我们犯了错误或者想要表达歉意时，我们会用 “I'm sorry.” 来表示“对不起”或者“抱歉”。在 “sorry” 前面加上 “really” 可以加强语气，表示“我真的很抱歉”。这是一种非常常用且礼貌的表达歉意的方式。

reading.en: Mei loves Chinese New Year. This year, she is in New York and visits Chinatown. It's her first time celebrating Chinese New Year in America. The streets are busy and full of red lanterns. Many people are wearing red clothes. Mei sees a lion dance. It's very exciting! She buys some lucky candies. Later, she watches a spectacular parade with dragons and drums. Everyone is smiling. Mei feels happy and a little bit homesick, but it's a wonderful day. She calls her family to wish them a Happy New Year.
reading.cn: 梅很喜欢春节。今年，她在纽约，去了唐人街。这是她第一次在美国过春节。街道很繁忙，挂满了红灯笼。许多人穿着红色的衣服。梅看到了一场舞狮表演。太棒了！她买了一些幸运糖果。后来，她观看了一场有龙和鼓的壮观游行。每个人都在微笑。梅感到高兴又有点想家，但这是美好的一天。她打电话给家人祝他们新年快乐。

reading.en: Mei's American host family, the Browns, enjoy the celebration with her. Mrs. Brown tells Mei, “This is so much fun! What a wonderful tradition!” Mr. Brown takes a lot of photos of the colorful lanterns and the dragon parade. “The culture is so rich,” he says. Mei tells them about her family's traditions, like making dumplings and giving red envelopes. They all have lunch together at a Chinese restaurant and try many delicious dishes. It's a special experience for everyone.
reading.cn: 梅的美国寄宿家庭布朗一家和她一起享受这个节日。布朗夫人告诉梅：“这太有趣了！多么美妙的传统啊！”布朗先生拍了很多彩色灯笼和舞龙游行的照片。他说：“文化太丰富了。”梅告诉他们她家的传统，比如包饺子和发红包。他们一起去一家中餐馆吃午饭，尝了很多美味的菜肴。这对每个人来说都是一次特别的经历。

reading.en: After the parade, they walk to a park where people are lighting fireworks. The sky is bright with beautiful colors. Mei remembers celebrating with fireworks back home. It's a sweet memory. She feels grateful for this new experience. “Happy Chinese New Year!” she says to the Browns. “Happy New Year, Mei!” they reply.
reading.cn: 游行结束后，他们走到一个公园，那里的人们正在放烟花。天空被美丽的色彩照亮。梅回忆起在家乡放烟花的场景。这是一个甜蜜的回忆。她感谢这次新的体验。“中国新年快乐！”她她对布朗一家说。“新年快乐，梅！”他们回答道。

reading.en: Mei realizes that no matter where she is, the spirit of Chinese New Year, with its joy and family warmth, remains the same. Being in Chinatown makes her feel connected to her roots, even far away from home. She knows she will always cherish this special day.
reading.cn: 梅意识到，无论身在何处，春节的欢乐和家庭温暖的精神都是一样的。在唐人街让她觉得自己与自己的根相连，即使远离家乡。她知道她将永远珍惜这个特殊的日子。

grammar.title: How was...? (询问过去经历)
grammar.explain: 我们用 “How was...?” 来询问某人对过去的经历或感受的看法。通常后面接一个名词，表示询问的是这个名词所代表的事物、事件或时间段。比如课文中的 “How was your weekend?” 就是询问“你的周末怎么样？”。
在回答 “How was...?” 的问题时，我们通常用 “It was + 形容词” 来描述。形容词可以是 positive (great, good)、negative (bad, terrible) 或 neutral (okay, busy)。

examples.en: It was great!
It was good, thank you.
It was busy, but fun.

grammar.title: It was great/good/busy. (描述过去经历)

Friend: Hey, how was your weekend?

reading.en: Mei is looking for an apartment for her parents. She's talking to her friend, Tom. “I want to find a nice place for my parents,” Mei says. “They like somewhere quiet and safe.” Tom replies, “There’s a good apartment complex on Elm Street. It’s very quiet.” Mei asks, “How about the facilities nearby? Is there a supermarket or a park?” Tom thinks for a moment. “Yes, there’s a big supermarket nearby, and there’s also a small park across the street. It’s very convenient. The rent is also reasonable.” Mei smiles. “That sounds perfect! Let’s go check it out this weekend.”
reading.cn: 梅正在为她的父母寻找一套公寓。她正在和她的朋友汤姆谈话。“我想为我父母找一个好地方，”梅说。“他们喜欢安静安全的地方。”汤姆回答说：“榆树街有一个不错的公寓小区。那里很安静。”梅问：“那附近设施怎么样？有超市或公园吗？”汤姆想了想。“是的，附近有一家大超市，街对面还有一个小公园。非常方便。租金也合理。”梅笑了。“听起来很完美！这个周末我们去看看吧。”
梅和汤姆参观了榆树街的公寓。梅很喜欢这套公寓。“它明亮又干净，”她说，“而且公园非常近！”汤姆补充道，“而且别忘了，附近有一家大超市，所以买菜很方便。”梅点点头。“是的，这真是太方便他们了。我想我父母会喜欢这个地方的。它安静、安全，附近也有他们需要的一切。”她决定把这里告诉她的父母。
reading.en: Mei and Tom visit the apartment on Elm Street. Mei likes the apartment. "It's bright and clean," she says. "And the park is so close!" Tom adds, "And remember, there's a big supermarket nearby, so it's easy to buy groceries." Mei nods. "Yes, that's really convenient for them. I think my parents will like this place. It's quiet, safe, and has everything they need nearby." She decides to tell her parents about it.

Mei calls her parents. “Hi Mom and Dad! I found a great apartment for you. It’s on Elm Street. There’s a big supermarket nearby and a park right across the street. The area is very quiet and safe.” Her mother asks, “What about the rent, Mei?” Mei replies, “It’s reasonable, and the apartment is bright and clean.” Her father then asks, “Is there a bus stop nearby?” Mei checks a map. “Yes, there’s one just two blocks away. It’s very convenient!” Her parents sound happy. They decide to move there next month.
reading.cn: 梅给她的父母打电话。“爸妈好！我给你们找到了一套很棒的公寓。它在榆树街。附近有一家大超市，街对面就有一个公园。这个区域非常安静和安全。”她妈妈问：“那租金怎么样，梅？”梅回答说：“很合理，而且公寓明亮又干净。”她爸爸接着问：“附近有公交车站吗？”梅查了一下地图。“是的，离这里只有两个街区。非常方便！”她的父母听起来很高兴。他们决定下个月搬到那里。

reading.en: A month later, Mei's parents move into the new apartment. They are very happy. "This place is perfect, Mei!" her mother says. "The supermarket is so close, and the park is lovely." Her father adds, "And it's so quiet here. We sleep very well." Mei is glad to see them comfortable. "I'm happy you like it," she says. "I knew 'there's a big supermarket nearby' was important for you."

reading.en: Mei's parents are visiting next month, and she needs an extra bed for them. She goes to a furniture store. A salesperson greets her. Mei points to a folding bed. "How much is this folding bed?" she asks. The salesperson checks the tag. "It's $150," he says. "Is it comfortable? My parents will sleep on it." The salesperson nods. "Yes, it's very comfortable, and it's easy to set up." Mei thinks about the price. "Do you have any discounts?" she asks. "Sorry, no discounts on this item right now," the salesperson replies. Mei decides to buy it. "I'll take it," she says. "Can I pay by card?" "Yes, of course," he smiles. Mei pays and gets the receipt. She's happy her parents will have a comfortable place to sleep.
reading.cn: 梅的父母下个月要来探望她，她需要一张额外的床给他们。她去了一家家具店。一个销售员迎接了她。梅指着一张折叠床问道：“这张折叠床多少钱？”销售员查看了标签。“150美元。”他说。“它舒服吗？我的父母会睡在上面。”销售员点点头。“是的，它很舒服，而且很容易安装。”梅考虑了一下价格。“你们有折扣吗？”她问。 “抱歉，这款商品目前没有折扣，”销售员回答。梅决定购买它。“我买了。”她说。“我可以用卡支付吗？” “是的，当然可以。”他笑着说。梅付了钱并拿到了收据。她很高兴她的父母将有一个舒适的地方睡觉。

grammar.explain:
在描述交通或到达某个地方时，我们经常会用到“to get to”和“to take”。

**To get to:** 表示“到达某个地方”。它强调的是抵达目的地的动作或结果。

**To take:** 表示“走（某条路/交通工具）”或“乘坐（某种交通工具）”。它强调的是选择的路线或方式。
grammar.title: Using 'to get to' for destination and 'to take' for routes

grammar.explain:
第一类条件句用于描述真实或可能发生的情况及其结果。结构是：If + 简单现在时, will + 动词原形。

If从句描述条件，主句描述结果。这种句型常用于讨论计划、预测或提出建议。

reading.en: Mei was excited to drive to Los Angeles. She had planned this trip for months. Her friend, Lily, was coming with her. "Are we taking the highway?" asked Lily. "Yes," replied Mei. "The GPS says to take I-5 South. It's usually faster, but we might hit some traffic near the city. We need to watch for the speed limit." As they drove, Mei saw a sign. "Oh, we need to get off at the next exit for gas," she said. "My tank is almost empty." Lily checked her phone. "Okay, I see a gas station just off the exit. Good planning, Mei!" Mei smiled, enjoying the open road. "This is going to be a fun trip!" she thought.
reading.cn: 梅对开车去洛杉矶感到很兴奋。她已经计划这次旅行好几个月了。她的朋友莉莉和她一起去。“我们走高速公路吗？”莉莉问道。“是的，”梅回答。“GPS说走I-5南。通常会快一些，但我们可能会在城市附近遇到一些交通。我们需要注意限速。”当她们开车时，梅看到一个标志。“哦，我们下一个出口需要下去加油了，”她说。“我的油箱快空了。”莉莉看了看手机。“好的，我看到一个加油站就在出口附近。计划得真好，梅！”梅微笑着，享受着开阔的道路。“这将是一次有趣的旅行！”她想。
一小时后，她们仍然在高速公路上。“哇，交通越来越堵了，”莉莉说。“我们要换车道吗？”梅检查了后视镜。“我们暂时先待在这个车道。频繁变道可能很危险。我们刚刚经过一个休息区的标志，如果我们需要休息，可以在那里靠边停车。”最终，交通变得畅通，她们继续前往阳光明媚的洛杉矶市。
reading.en: An hour later, they were still on the highway. "Wow, the traffic is getting heavy," said Lily. "Should we change lanes?" Mei checked her mirrors. "Let's stay in this lane for now. Moving too much can be dangerous. We just passed a sign for a rest area, so we can pull over there if we need a break." Eventually, the traffic cleared up, and they continued their journey to the sunny city of Los Angeles.

Mei loves driving to new places. She likes to explore different routes and see the scenery. Sometimes, she uses a map, but mostly she relies on her GPS for directions. "Driving gives me a sense of freedom," she often tells Lily. For this trip to LA, she made sure her car was in good condition and had plenty of gas. She hoped they would arrive before sunset.
reading.cn: 梅喜欢开车去新的地方。她喜欢探索不同的路线和欣赏风景。有时她会使用地图，但大多数时候她依靠GPS来指路。“开车给我一种自由的感觉，”她经常告诉莉莉。这次去洛杉矶的旅行，她确保了她的车况良好，并且加满了油。她希望她们能在日落前到达。
当她们最终到达洛杉矶郊区时，城市熙熙攘攘。莉莉指着说：“看，梅，那是好莱坞标志！”梅感到一阵满足。所有的计划和驾驶都值得了。她们用GPS很容易地找到了酒店。“是时候办理入住手续并去吃晚餐了，”梅停好车说。“真是一次冒险！”
reading.en: When they finally reached the outskirts of Los Angeles, the city was bustling. Lily pointed, "Look, Mei, there's the Hollywood sign!" Mei felt a wave of satisfaction. All the planning and driving were worth it. They found their hotel easily with the GPS. "Time to check in and find some dinner," Mei said, parking the car. "What an adventure!"

reading.cn: 梅的电话响时她正忙着。是她妈妈打来的。“嗨，妈！你们快到了吗？”梅问道。她妈妈说：“是的，我们刚到SFO。我们现在正在等行李。”梅迅速回答：“太好了！你打电话来时我正在做饭。我现在正要出发去接你们。你们在哪个登机口？”她妈妈告诉了她登机口号。梅说：“好的，我大概30分钟内到，这要看交通情况。”
reading.en: Mei was busy when her phone rang. It was her mom. "Hi, mom! Are you almost here?" Mei asked. Her mom said, "Yes, we just arrived at SFO. We're waiting for our luggage now." Mei quickly replied, "Great! I was cooking when you called. I'm leaving now to pick you up. What gate are you at?" Her mom told her the gate number. Mei said, "Okay, I'll be there in about 30 minutes, depending on the traffic."

reading.cn: 梅开车去了SFO。她查了手机上的航班状态。她父母的航班准时降落。她心想：“我希望交通不要太糟糕。”她到达后，给妈妈打了电话。“妈，我到了。我应该在哪里接你们？”她妈妈说：“我们在到达层路边，10号登机口附近。我们所有的行李都拿到了。”梅笑了笑。“太好了！我正在靠边停车。”
reading.en: Mei drove to SFO. She checked the flight status on her phone. Her parents' flight landed on time. She thought, "I hope the traffic isn't too bad." When she arrived, she called her mom. "Mom, I'm here. Where should I pick you up?" Her mom said, "We're at the arrivals curb, near Gate 10. We have all our luggage." Mei smiled. "Perfect! I'm pulling over now."

reading.cn: 很快，梅看到了她的父母。他们看起来都很开心，也有一点疲惫。“欢迎来到旧金山！”梅紧紧地拥抱了他们。“你们的航班怎么样？”她爸爸说：“很长，但是很好。幸好我们没错过转机。”梅帮他们拿行李，然后他们走向了车子。“我已经为我们做好了晚餐。”她说。她妈妈高兴地回答：“哦，太棒了！我饿坏了！”
reading.en: Soon, Mei saw her parents. They both looked happy and a little tired. "Welcome to San Francisco!" Mei hugged them tightly. "How was your flight?" Her dad said, "It was long, but good. We didn't miss our connecting flight, thankfully." Mei helped them with their luggage and they headed to the car. "I've already cooked dinner for us," she said. Her mom happily replied, "Oh, wonderful! I'm starving!"

reading.cn: 回到梅的公寓，他们享用了美味的晚餐。她妈妈问：“我们之前打电话时你在做什么？你听起来有点忙。”梅笑着说：“你打电话来时我正在给你们做晚饭呢！我想让你们到达时一切都准备好。”她的父母被她的细心感动了。他们聊着笑着，直到深夜，很高兴能在一起。
reading.en: Back at Mei's apartment, they enjoyed the delicious dinner. Her mom asked, "What were you doing when we called earlier? You sounded a bit busy." Mei laughed, "I was cooking dinner for you when you called! I wanted everything to be ready when you arrived." Her parents were very touched by her thoughtfulness. They talked and laughed late into the evening, happy to be together.

reading.cn: 大家好，爸爸妈妈！欢迎来到我的书店。我在这里工作一年了。这是一个好地方。这位是李经理。他非常和蔼。这位是莎拉。她帮助顾客找书。我通常是全职工作，但有时上课的时候我会兼职。我从去年七月开始在这里工作。我真的很喜欢我的工作。向人们推荐书籍很棒。你们可以在这里找到许多有趣的书。看看吧！
reading.en: Hello, Mom and Dad! Welcome to my bookstore. I have worked here for one year. It's a nice place. This is Mr. Lee, the manager. He is very kind. And this is Sarah. She helps customers find books. I usually work full-time, but sometimes I work part-time when I have classes. I started working here since last July. I really like my job. It's great to recommend books to people. You can find many interesting books here. Take a look!

reading.cn: 梅的妈妈：哇，梅，这个地方真棒！太舒服了。你在这里工作一整年了？真是太棒了！梅的爸爸：看到你开心真是太好了，梅。这看起来是一个很棒的环境。梅：是的，没错！我在这里学到了很多东西。而且我遇到了很多有趣的人。
reading.en: Mei's Mom: Wow, Mei, this place is wonderful! It's so cozy. And you've worked here for a whole year? That's amazing! Mei's Dad: It's good to see you happy, Mei. This looks like a great environment. Mei: Yes, it is! I've learned a lot here. And I've met so many interesting people.

reading.cn: 梅和戴维与他们的朋友汤姆和莎拉在一家新咖啡馆见面。“嗨，大家好！”梅说，“这是城里最好喝的咖啡。我是听我的寄宿家庭说的。”“真的吗？”汤姆说，“太棒了！下班后我正想来杯好咖啡呢。”莎拉看着菜单。“他们有好多选择啊！我想我尝尝冰拿铁。”戴维说，“我想要一杯热的无咖啡因咖啡，谢谢。”梅笑着说：“我还要点一大块苹果派。它看起来真好吃！”
reading.en: Mei and David meet their friends, Tom and Sarah, at a new coffee shop. "Hi, everyone!" says Mei. "This is the best coffee in town. I heard about it from my host family." "Really?" says Tom. "That's great! I'm ready for a good coffee after work." Sarah looks at the menu. "They have so many choices! I think I'll try an iced latte." David says, "I'd like a hot decaf coffee, please." Mei smiles, "I'm going to order a big slice of apple pie too. It looks delicious!"

reading.cn: 服务员来到他们的桌边。“你们准备好点餐了吗？”他问道。梅说：“是的，我想要一杯热拿铁，谢谢。再来一块苹果派。”戴维说：“我想要一杯无咖啡因咖啡。”汤姆说：“我要一杯普通咖啡，不加奶不加糖。”莎拉说：“我想要一杯冰拿铁，谢谢。”服务员记下他们的订单。“您的饮料和食物马上就来！”他说道。
reading.en: The waiter comes to their table. "Are you ready to order?" he asks. Mei says, "Yes, I'd like a hot latte, please. And a slice of apple pie." David says, "I'd like a decaf coffee." Tom says, "I'll have a regular coffee, black." Sarah says, "I'd like an iced latte, please." The waiter writes down their orders. "Your drinks and food will be right out!" he says.

reading.cn: 梅喝了一小口拿铁。“嗯，这个真好喝！我的寄宿家庭说得没错。”戴维的无咖啡因咖啡也非常好喝。汤姆享受着他的黑咖啡。莎拉的冰拿铁很清爽。他们都觉得这是一家很棒的咖啡馆。“我们应该再来这里。”汤姆说。“当然！”梅说。强调所有 8 个板块必须完全围绕这个核心场景和核心句型。
reading.en: Mei takes a sip of her latte. "Mmm, this is really good! My host family was right." David's decaf coffee is also very good. Tom enjoys his black coffee. Sarah's iced latte is refreshing. They all agree it's a great coffee shop. "We should come here again," says Tom. "Definitely!" says Mei.

reading.cn: 他们边喝饮料边吃糕点，边说边笑。梅告诉他们更多关于她的寄宿家庭和她在城市里的新生活。戴维分享了一些他工作中有趣的故事。汤姆和莎拉告诉他们周末的计划。在一起的时间过得真快。
reading.en: They talk and laugh while enjoying their drinks and pastry. Mei tells them more about her host family and her new life in the city. David shares some funny stories from his work. Tom and Sarah tell them about their plans for the weekend. Time flies when they are together.

reading.cn: 梅的父母明天就要走了。这是他们在美国的最后一天。梅的妈妈看起来有点累。“妈，你应该休息一下，”梅说，“我们可以晚点再收拾行李。”她爸爸同意道：“是的，你应该放松一下。我们明天的航班很早，所以我们需要早起。我们今晚把所有东西都准备好。”梅的妈妈笑了。“你说得对。我有点累。也许我小睡一会儿。”梅有点难过父母要走了，但她很高兴他们旅行愉快。
reading.en: Mei's parents are leaving tomorrow. It's their last day in the US. Mei's mom looks a little tired. "Mom, you should rest," Mei says. "We can pack our bags later." Her dad agrees, "Yes, you should relax. We have an early flight tomorrow, so we need to get up early. Let's make sure everything is ready tonight." Mei's mom smiles. "You're right. I'm a bit tired. Maybe I'll take a short nap." Mei feels a little sad her parents are leaving, but she's happy they had a good trip.

reading.cn: 梅帮妈妈在沙发上找了一个舒服的位置。“爸，您有什么需要帮忙的吗？”她问道。“不用，亲爱的，我快弄完了，”他回答，“只是再确认一下航班详情。”然后他对梅的妈妈说：“亲爱的，你今晚真的应该好好休息。航班很长。”梅的妈妈点点头，已经感到困倦。梅想着他们一起旅行的时光以及他们所有的乐趣。她会非常想念他们。
reading.en: Mei helps her mom find a comfortable spot on the sofa. "Dad, do you need help with anything?" she asks. "No, sweetie, I'm almost done," he replies. "Just checking the flight details one more time." He then says to Mei's mom, "Honey, you should really get some good rest tonight. The flight is long." Mei's mom nods, already feeling sleepy. Mei thinks about their trip together and all the fun they had. She'll miss them a lot.

reading.cn: 那天晚上晚些时候，梅的父母感觉好多了。他们收拾好行李，检查了所有早班机所需的物品。“谢谢你给我们带来了一次美妙的旅行，梅，”她妈妈说着拥抱了她。“我们玩得很开心。”她爸爸补充道：“你应该尽快来看我们！”梅微笑着，眼睛有点湿润。“我会的！你们两位都应该保重。祝你们一路平安！”他们享用了最后一顿家庭晚餐，充满了美好的回忆和很快再见面的承诺。
reading.en: Later that evening, Mei's parents feel much better. They finish packing and check everything for their early morning flight. "Thank you for a wonderful trip, Mei," her mom says, giving her a hug. "We had a great time." Her dad adds, "You should visit us soon!" Mei smiles, a little teary-eyed. "I will! You should take care, both of you. And have a safe flight home!" They share a last family dinner, full of warm memories and promises to see each other soon.

reading.cn: 上床睡觉前，梅确保她的父母拥有所需的一切。“别担心任何事，爸爸妈妈。放松并好好睡一觉。你们应该好好休息，为飞行做准备。”梅的父母被梅的关心感动了。“你真是个贴心的女儿，”她爸爸说，“我们很幸运有你。”他们道晚安，期待很快再次见面。梅知道告别很难，但她珍惜这些最后的时刻。
reading.en: Before they go to bed, Mei makes sure her parents have everything they need. "Don't worry about anything, Mom and Dad. Just relax and get some sleep. You should be well-rested for your flight." Her parents are touched by Mei's care. "You're such a thoughtful daughter," her dad says. "We're so lucky to have you." They say goodnight, looking forward to seeing each other again soon. Mei knows saying goodbye is hard, but she cherishes these last moments.

reading.en: Mei looked out the window of the train. Two years. It felt like yesterday she arrived in this country, a little nervous but full of hope. Now, the second year of her studies, her Level 2 journey, was officially complete. She was going home. Her host family, the Browns, had given her a warm farewell. Mrs. Brown even packed her a special lunch for the journey. "We'll miss you, Mei," Mr. Brown had said, giving her a hug. Mei smiled, a mix of sadness and excitement in her heart. She took out her journal, a small notebook filled with memories and new words. She wanted to reflect on her journey, to capture all the feelings before she truly went home.

随着火车疾驰，梅想起了她所学到的一切新事物，不仅仅是英语，还有关于她自己的。她交了朋友，探索了新的地方，克服了挑战。她的英语变得更加自信，尤其是在达到Level 2之后。她现在可以更好地表达自己，理解更复杂的对话，甚至可以用英语表达自己的感受。整个经历是一个巨大的里程碑。她知道她会永远珍藏这些回忆。她迫不及待地想和家里的亲人分享这一切。

grammar.explain: 英语中，名词可以分为可数名词和不可数名词。可数名词是指可以数数的名词，有单数和复数形式。不可数名词是指不能数数的名词，通常没有复数形式，不能直接用数字来修饰。

grammar.explain: 在餐厅点餐时，通常用 "I'd like..." 来表达“我想要…”。这是一种非常礼貌和常用的表达方式。 "I'd like" 是 "I would like" 的缩写。

在点餐时，我们会用到 a/an, some 和 any。
* a/an 用于修饰单数可数名词。
* some 用于肯定句中，修饰复数可数名词或不可数名词，表示“一些”。
* any 用于疑问句和否定句中，修饰复数可数名词或不可数名词，表示“任何”或“一些”。

reading.cn: 梅正在一家小餐馆里。她看着菜单。服务员来到她的桌边。他问道：“你好，准备好点餐了吗？” 梅微笑着说：“是的，谢谢。我想要一个披萨和一些水。” 服务员记了下来。“还需要别的吗？” 梅想了一会儿。“不用了，就这些，谢谢。” 服务员说：“好的。一个披萨和一些水。马上就来！”
reading.en: Mei is at a small restaurant. She's looking at the menu. The waiter comes to her table. "Hello, are you ready to order?" he asks. Mei smiles. "Yes, please. I'd like a pizza, and some water, please." The waiter writes it down. "Anything else?" Mei thinks for a moment. "No, that's all, thank you." The waiter says, "Okay. One pizza and some water. Coming right up!"

reading.cn: 后来，服务员带来了梅点的餐。“这是您的披萨和水，”他说。“请慢用！” 梅看着披萨。这是一个完整的披萨，而不是一片。她还有一瓶水。她开始吃了。“这真好吃！”她想。她很快喝完了水。“打扰一下，”她叫来服务员。“我能再来些水吗？” 服务员点点头，又给她拿来了一瓶。
reading.en: Later, the waiter brings Mei's order. "Here's your pizza and your water," he says. "Enjoy your meal!" Mei looks at the pizza. It's a whole pizza, not just a slice. She also has a bottle of water. She starts to eat. "This is delicious!" she thinks. She finishes her water quickly. "Excuse me," she calls for the waiter. "Can I have some more water, please?" The waiter nods and brings her another bottle.

reading.cn: 梅吃完了饭。她感觉很饱很开心。她要了账单。服务员把账单拿来了。“一共十五美元，”他说。梅用卡付了钱。“谢谢你提供了一顿美餐，”她对服务员说。他回答说：“不客气。欢迎下次再来！” 梅离开了餐馆，已经在想下次再来了。
reading.en: Mei finishes her meal. She feels full and happy. She asks for the bill. The waiter brings it. "That'll be fifteen dollars," he says. Mei pays with her card. "Thank you for a lovely meal," she says to the waiter. He replies, "You're welcome. Come again soon!" Mei leaves the restaurant, already thinking about her next visit.

reading.cn: 梅拿起电话拨了号码。“您好，我是梅。我能和戴维斯先生通话吗？”电话那头的人回答说：“抱歉，戴维斯先生正在开会。他现在没空。”梅停顿了一下，然后问道：“哦，这样啊。我能给他留个口信吗？”“好的，当然可以。您有什么口信？”“请告诉他，梅来过电话，我想把我们的预约改到下周二。您能请他有空的时候给我回个电话吗？我的电话是555-1234。”“好的，我明白了。我一定让他收到口信。还有其他事吗？”“没有了，就这些。谢谢！”梅挂了电话，希望戴维斯先生能尽快给她回电话。
reading.en: Mei picked up her phone and dialed the number. "Hello, this is Mei speaking. May I speak to Mr. Davis, please?" The person on the other end replied, "I'm sorry, Mr. Davis is in a meeting right now. He's not available." Mei paused, then asked, "Oh, I see. Can I leave a message for him?" "Yes, of course. What's your message?" "Please tell him Mei called, and I'd like to reschedule our appointment for next Tuesday. Could you ask him to call me back when he's free? My number is 555-1234." "Got it. I'll make sure he gets the message. Is there anything else?" "No, that's all. Thank you!" Mei hung up, hoping Mr. Davis would call her back soon.

Later that afternoon, Mei received a call. It was Mr. Davis! "Hello Mei, I just got your message. Thanks for calling! Next Tuesday works for me. What time would be good for you?" Mei smiled. "How about 10 AM?" "Perfect! See you then, Mei." Mei was glad they could easily contact each other and reschedule.
reading.cn: 那天下午晚些时候，梅接到了一个电话。是戴维斯先生！“你好，梅，我刚收到你的口信。谢谢你打电话！下周二我方便。你觉得什么时间好？”梅笑了。“上午10点怎么样？”“太好了！到时候见，梅。”梅很高兴他们能轻松联系到彼此并重新安排。

reading.en: This scenario highlights common phrases and etiquette used when making phone calls, especially when the person you wish to speak with is unavailable. Knowing how to leave a clear message and request a call back is a crucial communication skill.
reading.cn: 这个场景突出了打电话时常用的短语和礼仪，尤其是在你想要通话的人不在的时候。知道如何留下清晰的口信并请求回电是一项重要的沟通技能。
这也在提醒我们，即使无法直接联系到某人，也要始终保持礼貌和清晰。提供你的姓名、通话原因和联系方式，会方便对方进行回复。
reading.en: It's also a good reminder to always be polite and clear, even when you can't reach someone directly. Providing your name, reason for calling, and contact information makes it easy for the other person to respond.

grammar.explain: 关系代词 (Relative Pronouns) 用于引导定语从句，修饰主句中的名词或代词，使其意义更清晰。本课主要学习 who, which 和 that。

grammar.explain:
以 -ed 结尾的形容词通常用来描述人的感受和情绪，表示“感到……的”。例如 interested（感到兴趣的），bored（感到无聊的），excited（感到兴奋的）。

以 -ing 结尾的形容词通常用来描述事物或情况的特点，表示“令人……的”。例如 interesting（令人感兴趣的），boring（令人无聊的），exciting（令人兴奋的）。

grammar.title: If it rains, I'll stay home. (第一条件句)
grammar.explain:
第一条件句用来谈论当前或将来可能发生的情况及其导致的结果。它由两部分组成：一个 'if' 从句（条件）和一个主句（结果）。

**结构：**
If + 主语 + 动词现在时态 (if 从句), 主语 + will + 动词原形 (主句)

**If 从句:** 描述条件。动词用一般现在时。
**主句:** 描述结果。动词用 'will' + 动词原形。

examples.cn: 如果他来了，我们就开始游戏。
examples.en: If he comes, we'll start the game.

examples.cn: 如果她喜欢咖啡，我会给她买一杯。
examples.en: If she likes coffee, I'll buy her one.
If it snows, the roads will be slippery.

grammar.title: 动词变位提醒 (第三人称单数)
grammar.explain: 在 'if' 从句中，如果主语是第三人称单数 (he, she, it)，动词要加 '-s' 或 '-es'。

reading.cn: 星期六的早晨，梅正看向窗外。“哦不，天气真多云，”她想道。她原本计划和朋友们骑自行车。早餐时，她和寄宿家庭的妈妈史密斯夫人聊天。梅说：“如果下雨，我就待在家里。也许我可以看书或看电影。”史密斯夫人微笑着说：“那是个好主意！但是你看，太阳正努力探出头来。如果天晴了，我们晚些时候我们可以去公园！”梅感到更高兴了。“真的吗？如果天晴，我很想和你一起去！”史密斯夫人说：“是的，如果刮风，我们也可以在那里放风筝！我们等着看看天气吧。”梅希望太阳会赢！
reading.en: It's Saturday morning, and Mei is looking out the window. "Oh no, it's so cloudy," she thinks. She had a plan to go cycling with her friends. She chats with her host mother, Mrs. Smith, at breakfast. Mei says, "If it rains, I'll stay home. Maybe I can read a book or watch a movie." Mrs. Smith smiles, "That's a good idea! But look, the sun is trying to come out. If it gets sunny, we can go to the park later!" Mei feels happier. "Really? If it's sunny, I'd love to go with you!" Mrs. Smith says, "Yes, and if it's windy, we can fly a kite there too! Let's wait and see the weather." Mei hopes the sun will win!

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，乌云散去，太阳出来了！梅、史密斯夫人，甚至史密斯先生都去了公园。天气非常适合放风筝。梅明白如果她耐心等待，好事可能会发生。
reading.en: Later that day, the clouds cleared, and the sun came out! Mei, Mrs. Smith, and even Mr. Smith went to the park. The weather was perfect for flying a kite. Mei learned that if she waited, good things might happen.

reading.cn: 他们回到家时，史密斯夫人问：“梅，如果明天雪，你会做什么？”梅想了一会儿说：“如果下雪，我就堆雪人！如果太冷，我就待在室内喝热巧克力！”史密斯夫人笑了，“好计划！”
reading.en: When they came back home, Mrs. Smith asked, "Mei, if it snows tomorrow, what will you do?" Mei thought for a moment and said, "If it snows, I'll build a snowman! And if it's too cold, I'll stay inside and drink hot chocolate!" Mrs. Smith laughed, "Good plans!"

reading.cn: 梅意识到，即使她的原计划因为天气而改变，她仍然可以度过美好的一天。
reading.en: Mei realized that even if her original plans changed due to the weather, she could still have a wonderful day.
